info.title: AGN NIGRAAN Backend Interface Contracts
info.description:
Endpoint contracts generated from the current deployment-readiness, connection-profile, synchronization, repository, workflow, identity and persistence-aware frontend registry.

WHAT THIS DOCUMENT GUARANTEES: every request body, path parameter and query parameter is typed from the same contract objects the running validator reads, and every endpoint that declares required response fields carries them in a named component and in x-agn-response on the operation.

WHAT IT DOES NOT: the contracts declare required field NAMES for responses, not their types, so a response component states what must be present and leaves the shape of each field to the backend. Request bodies are strict (additionalProperties:false) where the contract enumerates fields; responses are open (additionalProperties:true). Where a component is shared between endpoints, its `required` is the intersection - read x-agn-response for the per-operation set that AGN.backendInterfaces.validateResponse actually enforces.
